assets.name: wood
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless repeating base-color texture for the wooden arch and counter of a warm European station ticket office in a polished stylized 3D board game. Generate a single flat square material swatch, edge-to-edge. Natural medium-dark warm walnut brown, approximate average sRGB #765039. Subtle irregular horizontal flowing wood grain with varied long fibers, occasional very faint broad growth curves; fine matte surface, quiet wear. Grain follows X. This must tile seamlessly on all four edges. Orthographic flat albedo under perfectly even neutral light. No highlights, no shadows, no perspective, no vignette, no boards/plank seams, no frames, no objects, no text, no straight periodic stripes or knots that will dominate repetition. Intended final tile512x512. Low contrast so repetition2x4 remains natural.
